source.title: Birds New Zealand, Checklist of the Birds of New Zealand, sixth edition (2024), Supplementary Material 1
source.scope: All 432 species in the main checklist; excludes subspecies, hybrids, fossil-only Appendix 1 and failed introductions in Appendix 2. Includes main islands, Chatham, Kermadec and NZ subantarctic islands. Names and status are factual data; descriptions and media are not copied.
